title: Amelia found able to spell, read minds, see spirits and know other languages

tellings.quote: discovered that Amelia was in there and could spell and then that she could read her mind and then that she was seeing stuff that that Mora the mother couldn't see she could see spirits and ghosts and then she started saying that she knew other languages and she could identify hieroglyphics and knew Hebrew and Portuguese and Spanish

plain: A girl named Amelia, who had seemed unable to communicate, turned out to be "in there" around 2020 and 2021, and her family found she could spell, then read her mother Mora's mind, and see spirits and ghosts her mother couldn't. She went on to say she knew other languages, could pick out Egyptian hieroglyphics, and knew Hebrew, Portuguese and Spanish. The filmmaker Ky Dickens, who made The Telepathy Tapes, a documentary series about children said to read minds, tells Michels the story as the family told it to her. If true, it would mean some children who seem shut off have abilities far beyond what anyone expected.
